# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- The game layout must support both 1080p and 1200+ displays; the picture panel must stay bottom-aligned, and its row should differ by resolution, while 1200+ keeps extra visible log rows.

## SpellInfo Behavior
- F-keys must still assign quick slots while the SpellInfo page is open.
- Item-only actions like drop/use/move/split must not work while SpellInfo is open.
